Counsel for Petitioner :- Brij Bhushan Singh,Bheem Singh,Pranjal Apurva,Sandeep Kumar Mi Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.

Hon'ble Rajan Roy,J.
Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Shri S. N. Tilhari, learned A.G.A. for the State.

The petitioner seeks issuance of a writ in the nature of certiorari quashing First Information Report bearing Case Crime No. 0016 of 2024, under Sections 376, 392, 506 IPC, Police Station- Khodare,
District- Gonda.

The contention of the petitioner's counsel is that a financial transaction had taken place between the informant and the petitioner under which Rs.97,000/- was paid by the petitioner in cash to her for construction of a house.

As she was not returning the same, therefore, pressure was exhorted by the petitioner, as such, in these circumstances, just to regal out of the said obligation this F.I.R. has been filed by the informant.

Learned A.G.A. says that plea taken by the petitioner con not be considered under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, as, it is a matter of investigation.
As far as the contents of the F.I.R. are concerned, they clearly make out a cognizable offence.
We find from the F.I.R. that petitioner is the 'Mausa' of the informant and there are allegations of rape by her.
She has stated the ever since her childhood she has been subjected to physical abuse by the petitioner taking advantage of the circumstances narrated in the F.I.R which continued till recently.
In these circumstances, at least at this stage, we can no say that no cognizable offence is made out.
We can not stop investigation nor can quash the F.I.R. in such circumstances.
Petitioner's plea as noted hereinabove will have to be seen during investigation.
The petitioner may pursue other remedies as far as permissible in law.

Subject to above, the writ petition is dismissed.
.

(Rajeev Singh,J.) (Rajan Roy,J.) Order Date :- 14.3.2024 R.K.P.
